_doc: written by studio/scripts/audio_cast_probe.mjs from src/videos/antitheft/cast.ts stage(id, f) + toon.ts swapPath, run in node with a no-op canvas (no render). Picture FACTS per shot: fx: family -> [first f, last f, x, y (px of 1080x1920 at the first f), in frame?, key]; notes: whistle-note births; holds: [f, actor, hand, from, to, hand target, x, y, in frame?]; modes: [f, actor, from, to, x, y, in frame?]; walks: actor -> foot contacts [f, x, y, in frame?]; hands: first whisper-hand frame; pocketHands: actor#hand -> [f, dy, px per unit, in frame?, x, y]; panel (shot 8); tag_rot (shot 15); A5: fx rows end with [first in-frame f, last in-frame f]; vis: actor -> runs of frames with the head in frame; props (shot 14): bucket / pile -> [f, x, y, in frame?]; stage() gets vf = toNew(f). sfx.py picture_events() matches its cues to these (picture_events.json still wins). Screen positions ignore occlusion.
